canonical_statement: Every nonzero finitely generated commutative algebra R over a field k admits an injective k-algebra map from a polynomial algebra in finitely many variables to R such that R is finite over that polynomial algebra; the induced morphism from Spec R to the corresponding affine space is finite.
domain_and_universes: universe u; k R : Type u; Field k; CommRing R; Nontrivial R; Algebra k R; Algebra.FiniteType k R; Prop in Lean universe 0
conclusion: There exist s : Nat, an injective finite k-algebra map g : MvPolynomial (Fin s) k ->a[k] R, and a finite morphism f : Spec R -> AffineSpace (Fin s) (Spec k) whose composite with AffineSpace.SpecIso.hom is Spec.map g.toRingHom.
